name: KindLink
shortDescription: A charity CRM and fundraising platform with free supporter records, UK Gift Aid tools, online donations, contactless payments and paid advanced plans.
suitableContexts: UK charities and churches wanting a free donor CRM and Gift Aid records
Teams that need online, contactless or Direct Debit giving alongside supporter management

pricing.summary: KindLink publishes a free registered-nonprofit plan, Premium at £25/month excluding VAT and Expert at £45/month excluding VAT. Premium and Expert have 7-day trials; bank and Stripe fees apply and KindLink says it takes no part of donations.

tiers.label: Free
tiers.detail: Unlimited supporter records, UK Gift Aid records and online donation links; bank and Stripe fees apply

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.detail: Automated Gift Aid submission, website donation flow and multi-user access

tiers.label: Expert
tiers.detail: Adds UK Direct Debit, contactless/POS and more payment options

coreFeatures: UK Gift Aid records and reports
Contactless and POS giving on Expert
integrations: Xero and QuickBooks listed as coming in 2026
support: Onboarding and training on paid plans

editorial.assessment: KindLink provides an unusually strong UK Gift Aid feature set at a free entry point, but it is charity software rather than a complete church operating system. A church should verify its live HMRC submission workflow, payment-provider terms and the boundary between donor CRM and ministry records.
bestFor: UK charities needing a free supporter CRM with Gift Aid records
Churches combining online, Direct Debit and contactless giving with donor management
strengths: Published UK Gift Aid tools and GBP pricing
Free plan includes unlimited supporter records and exports
limitations: Some advertised integrations and fields are marked as coming in 2026
Not a substitute for service planning, safeguarding or complete charity accounting

longForm.verdict: KindLink is worth considering for a church whose immediate need is UK donor data and Gift Aid administration rather than a full church-management suite. Its free plan makes a carefully bounded pilot practical.

decisionLens.heading: Confirm which records belong in the fundraising CRM.
decisionLens.text: A donor CRM can hold valuable financial and consent information, but churches also hold pastoral and safeguarding-sensitive records that may need different controls. Define what enters KindLink, who can see it and how it reconciles with finance before importing contacts.

sections.heading: UK Gift Aid alongside donor CRM
sections.question: Can the finance team own the end-to-end giving workflow?
paragraphs: KindLink publishes a free plan with supporter management, UK Gift Aid recording, online donation links and exports. Its paid plans add automated Gift Aid submission, Direct Debit and contactless options.

Use a test account to record a sample gift, declaration and report, then check how it reaches the accountant or treasurer. Confirm processor fees and the status of any features described as coming in 2026 before including them in a requirements list.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on KindLink’s official pricing, feature and FAQ pages.
themes: The free plan enables a focused donor-CRM pilot.
Gift Aid automation and payment options need finance-team verification.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier information does not establish a church’s own Gift Aid eligibility, HMRC process or data-governance design.

faq.question: Is KindLink free?
faq.answer: Yes. KindLink states that its Free plan is available to registered nonprofits and includes supporter records, UK Gift Aid records and online donation links.

faq.question: Does KindLink have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. KindLink advertises a seven-day trial for Premium and Expert plans.

faq.question: Does KindLink support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Yes, according to the supplier. Its plans list UK Gift Aid recording, reports and automated submission on paid plans. Verify the exact HMRC workflow before use.

faq.question: How much does KindLink cost?
faq.answer: Published paid plans are £25 per month excluding VAT for Premium and £45 per month excluding VAT for Expert. Bank and Stripe fees can still apply.
